Name: Cute Recolors for Compact Bathroom and Modular Compact Bathroom
Author: manzanaOnline
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I love the compact bathroom mod. This is a recolor meant for the [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-AQy9Dy6Mp8HMnO22l3CZfdjOQr1QU9h?usp=drive_link]updated CP version [/url]of the original mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Luniartic]Luniartic[/url] As such it only contains the .png files[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Download Modular Compact Bathroom by [color=#ff7700][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Luniartic]Luniarti[/url]c[/color]
2. Extract onto your Mods folder.
3. Select either option A or B and copy the file that says "zcompactbathroom_tiles.png"
4. Paste "zcompactbathroom_tiles.png" and click to replace the original file
Ready!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI
Content Patcher
Modular Compact Bathroom
